_comment: Master dashboard which holds all the possible visualisation. Note new dashboards/visualisations can be added

charts.name: DSS_ITN_MAP_REG_HH_POINTS
charts._comment: Point layer copied from the Abia householdPointMap pattern. scaling is indexed by boundary drill depth from the dashboard scope; the last entry repeats for deeper levels. hitsCap = count below which individual households are drawn instead of clusters.
